memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, manages vegetable stall, walks unaided.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: no falls in past 12 months; gait steady; TUG 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 3 regular (salbutamol MDI SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS); polypharmacy not present.
mood: reports good spirits, denies anxiety.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goal: "I want to keep working at the market without breathlessness."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler 2 puffs BD
montelukast sodium 10 mg tablet HS

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 2.1 L (68% predicted), FVC 2.8 L (82% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.75. Post-bronchodilator FEV1 2.4 L (78% predicted), improvement 14% (significant reversibility).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been using my rescue inhaler about 3-4 times a week, especially after climbing stairs at the market. Nighttime cough twice weekly.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) for asthma follow-up.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: still independent, occasional shortness of breath on exertion at stall.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: none; gait slightly slower; TUG 11 seconds (borderline).
medicines: 3 regular; polypharmacy not present.
mood: mild frustration about inhaler use.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goal: "I’d like to cut down my rescue inhaler to less than twice a week."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler 1 puff BD (step down)
montelukast sodium 10 mg tablet HS

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Peak flow monitoring over 2 weeks: morning average 340 L/min (80% personal best), evening average 310 L/min (73% personal best), diurnal variability 15%.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports improved exercise tolerance, able to walk to market without stopping.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: none; gait normal; TUG 10 seconds.
medicines: 3 regular; polypharmacy not present.
mood: satisfied with current regimen.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goal: "I want to keep my asthma under control so I can work full days."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler 2 puffs BD (step up)
montelukast sodium 10 mg tablet HS

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Dr S. Rao, Pulmonology, Victoria Hospital, for Persistent asthma symptoms despite step-up therapy; request spirometry with reversibility and consideration of biologic therapy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonary review: Spirometry shows FEV1 2.2 L (70% predicted), post-BD 2.5 L (80% predicted), improvement 14%. No indication for biologics; recommend continuing current inhaled corticosteroid/long-acting beta-agonist and montelukast, ensure inhaler technique.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: able to work full market days, occasional wheeze after exertion.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: none; gait normal; TUG 10 seconds.
medicines: 3 regular; polypharmacy not present.
mood: content.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goal: "I want to stay active and avoid hospital visits."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler 2 puffs BD
montelukast sodium 10 mg tablet HS

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 2.3 L (73% predicted), FVC 2.9 L (85% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.79. Post-bronchodilator FEV1 2.5 L (79% predicted), improvement 9% (borderline reversibility).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent, market work unchanged, no limitation.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative) (annual screen).
falls: none in past year; gait normal; TUG 10 seconds.
medicines: 3 regular; polypharmacy not present.
mood: positive.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goal: "I wish to continue selling vegetables and enjoy time with my grandchildren."
